question: A boy standing in front of a magic mirror combination finds his head enlarged, body of same size and legs smaller in size. The mirrors used in the top, middle and bottom of the magic mirror arrangement in the respective order are:
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The boy's head appears enlarged, indicating the use of a **concave mirror** at the top.
 
• The body appears of the same size, indicating the use of a **plane mirror** in the middle.
 
• The legs appear smaller, indicating the use of a **convex mirror** at the bottom.
 
• Thus, the correct arrangement of mirrors from top to bottom is **concave, plane, convex**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Concave mirrors** converge light and can produce magnified images when the object is placed close to the mirror.
 
• **Plane mirrors** reflect light without altering the size of the image.
 
• **Convex mirrors** diverge light and can produce diminished images of objects.
 
• These properties of mirrors are utilized in various applications, including in magic mirrors to create interesting visual effects.
